name: Glass Half Broken
source:
Polina, a freshman from a poor family, moves to a corrupt industrial city in modern Russia to study economics and escape poverty. As she tries to build a future in a world shaped by inequality, hypocrisy, temptation, and unstable relationships, every choice pulls her deeper into a life where survival, ambition, and desire rarely stay separate.​

[From F95Zone]
